limitations: A 4096x131072x4096 panel with complete milestone/hash/target work, not an entire mining attempt.
Noise generation, uploads, allocation, CPU references and diagnostic dumps outside timing; timed kernels have no digest-capture instrumentation.
Exhaustive GPU comparisons cover every tile XOR and digest on a 256x256 panel. Larger checks sample three XOR tiles at all 32 milestones.
Normal boost, unchanged power cap; no locked-frequency claim, dynamic hardware counters, energy-per-share measurement or live pool comparison.
Static SASS counts are not dynamic stall/instruction counts. LDS counts exclude the LDSM mnemonic.
No RTX 3090 validation or passed Compute Sanitizer instrumentation.
